revision: v2 — added cockpit frontend projection and widget surface

observability_jsonl.key_fields: event_id, session_id, parent_session_id, sequence, created_at, event_name, event_hash, payload, producer, receipt_candidate

receipts_jsonl.key_fields: event_index, event_name, evidence_kind, evidence_relative_path, evidence_sha256, receipt_sha256, session_id, sequence

trace_events_jsonl.key_fields: trace_id, span_id, parent_span_id, event_kind, timestamp, event_type, payload

architecture.principle: DuckDB is a disposable read-side analytical lens. Never a mutation authority, coordination store, consent store, or persistent database. Every projection is recomputed from canonical sources on each invocation.

layers.name: Canonical Sources
layers.description: 389 JSON Schema-governed artifacts. Append-only JSONL or versioned JSON. No DuckDB dependency required to read.

layers.name: Read-Side Ingestion
layers.description: Python analytics engine reads canonical sources into disposable in-memory DuckDB. Schema validation via jsonschema at ingest time.
layers.duckdb_use: In-memory DuckDB (:memory:). Opened, queried, closed. No persistent file.

layers.name: Analytics Projection Engine
layers.description: Pre-built analytics views computed from DuckDB queries. Results are packaged as content-light projection envelopes and exposed via WebSocket to the frontend, via CLI to agents, and via SQL to analysts.
layers.duckdb_use: CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW in memory. Results serialized as projection envelopes.

layers.name: Frontend Cockpit Surface
layers.description: Analytics widgets rendered in the pywebview desktop cockpit. Widgets at three disclosure levels (compact chips, standard cards, full-page expanded). Fed by WebSocket projection stream. Frontend is a dumb renderer — backend owns all policy and analytics computation.
layers.duckdb_use: None in frontend. Backend projects DuckDB results through ProjectionWebSocketServer.

layers.name: Agent and Analyst Access
layers.description: CLI for agents (structured JSON output). SQL for analysts (DuckDB query surface). CSV/Parquet export for external tooling.
layers.duckdb_use: CLI wraps DuckDB. SQL passed through verbatim.

architecture.content_light_guarantee: All observable telemetry data is content-light by design. Raw prompts and completions are SHA256-hashed. Secrets redacted. Analytics layer reads only schema-governed, content-light artifacts. No raw prompt, completion, credential, secret, private file content, or repository content is ever exposed through the analytics query surface or frontend projection.

frontend_cockpit.design_principle: Frontend is a dumb renderer. Backend owns all policy, analytics computation, and projection. Frontend receives projection fields and renders them as human labels. Frontend never infers or overrides analytics. The existing ProjectionWebSocketServer pattern is reused — no new transport protocol.

disclosure_levels.compact_chip: Single-line status chips in the status bar or sidebar. Clicking expands to standard card.
disclosure_levels.standard_card: Mid-size card widgets in the analytics panel. Shows headline metrics, sparklines, and a 'View details' link.
disclosure_levels.full_page_expanded: Full-page expanded view with sortable tables, time-series charts, and export controls.

widgets.title: Governance Gate Health
widgets.description: Live summary of governance gate decisions: allowed vs blocked vs failed_closed across all gates. Color-coded by severity.
widgets.card_display: Bar chart: gate on Y-axis, decision count on X-axis, stacked by severity. Top 5 gates shown. 'View all' expands to full page.
widgets.full_page_display: Sortable table with columns: gate, decision, severity, count, last_seen. Filter by decision class, severity, session. Export to CSV.

widgets.title: Session Health
widgets.description: Per-session metrics: event count, tool success rate, context assembly count, receipt chain valid, governance decisions. Current session highlighted.
widgets.compact_display: Session: 847 events · 94% tool success · receipts valid
widgets.card_display: Scorecard with 6 metrics. Color indicators: green (healthy), yellow (degraded), red (blocked).

widgets.title: Tool Latency Distribution
widgets.description: Latency distribution per tool: p50, p95, p99. Heatmap by tool name over recent sessions. Spot slow tools.
widgets.card_display: Heatmap grid: tool name (rows) × session (columns), cell color = p95 latency. Top 10 tools, last 10 sessions.
widgets.full_page_display: Full heatmap with all tools and sessions. Time-series line chart: p50/p95/p99 over time for selected tool.

widgets.title: Release Gate Blocker Burndown
widgets.description: RC blocker status by phase. Open, in_progress, resolved, deferred. Trend over time.
widgets.card_display: Stacked bar: phase on X-axis, count on Y-axis, stacked by status. Total blockers: 16.
widgets.full_page_display: Burndown chart: open blockers over time. Table with blocker details: id, phase, status, title, blocked_by.

widgets.title: Dependency Risk Surface
widgets.description: Dependency classification summary from the dependency audit. canonical_keep vs remove_candidate vs needs_justification.
widgets.card_display: Donut chart: classification distribution (37 canonical, 26 test-only, 6 candidates, 1 needs review).
widgets.full_page_display: Filterable table with columns: package, classification, decision, reason, risk_surface, import_count. Search by package name. Sort by any column.

widgets.title: Out-of-Scope Findings
widgets.description: Findings registry: status, severity, blocked_by relationships. Dependency graph of findings that block other findings.
widgets.card_display: Summary: open vs resolved vs deferred. Severity distribution. Top 5 blocks.
widgets.full_page_display: Dependency graph: nodes = findings (color by severity), edges = blocked_by. Click node to see details. Table below graph.

widgets.title: Correlation Integrity
widgets.description: Cross-store correlation health: trace-to-session, receipt-to-event, session-to-parent. Gap detection, orphans, duplicates.
widgets.card_display: Per-correlation-path status: trace→session, receipt→event, session→parent. Gap count and example IDs for each.

widgets.title: Local Inference Capability
widgets.description: Local inference endpoint health, benchmark evidence, routing recommendations. From the local inference lane.
widgets.compact_display: Local: llama.cpp · healthy · 3 models · benchmarks available
widgets.card_display: Metrics: endpoint status, model count, benchmark pass rate, recommended route distribution.
widgets.full_page_display: Full capacity scan results, model fit plans, benchmark run history, routing decisions.

backend_integration.projection_server: Existing ProjectionWebSocketServer in rig_relay/desktop/websocket_server.py. Extended with analytics projection fields.
backend_integration.projection_schema: Existing rig.relay.desktop_projection.v1 schema. Extended with analytics top-level key containing widget projection data.
backend_integration.refresh_timer: Existing _poll_and_push() loop extended to include analytics refresh at widget-specific intervals.
backend_integration.content_light: Analytics projection data is content-light: counts, aggregates, hashes, status enums, timestamps. No raw prompts, completions, secrets, or private file content.

agent_access.output_format: JSON to stdout (--json), CSV to derived artifacts (--csv), structured summary (default)
example_queries: Which governance gates are blocking the most tool calls?
How many RC blockers remain across all phases?
What is the tool success rate trend across the last 10 sessions?
Which out-of-scope findings block other findings?
How many sessions have active receipt chains?

analyst_access.interface: DuckDB SQL via `--sql` flag, or direct DuckDB CLI on exported derived artifacts.
sql_examples: SELECT payload->>'$.gate' AS gate, payload->>'$.decision' AS decision, payload->>'$.severity' AS severity, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM '~/.rig/relay/sessions/*/observability.jsonl' WHERE event_name = 'rig.relay.governance.gate.decision' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 4 DESC

WITH sessions AS (SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) AS event_count, MAX(created_at) AS last_seen FROM '~/.rig/relay/sessions/*/observability.jsonl' GROUP BY 1), receipts AS (SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) AS receipt_count FROM '~/.rig/relay/sessions/*/receipts.jsonl' GROUP BY 1) SELECT s.session_id, s.event_count, COALESCE(r.receipt_count, 0) AS receipt_count, s.last_seen FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN receipts r ON s.session_id = r.session_id ORDER BY s.last_seen DESC
SELECT status, phase, COUNT(*) FROM 'docs/json/release_gate/rc_blockers.v1.jsonl' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC
SELECT classification, COUNT(*) FROM 'docs/json/testing/*.jsonl' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT classification, COUNT(*) FROM '.build/rig-relay/derived/dependency_surface_audit_v1.csv' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

cockpit_access.interface: Desktop cockpit via pywebview. WebSocket projection stream from ProjectionWebSocketServer.
cockpit_access.interaction: Widgets render at compact/standard/expanded disclosure levels. Click to expand. Hover for tooltips. Search and filter in full-page mode. Export to CSV from full-page mode.
cockpit_access.content_light: All data in projection is aggregated, hashed, or enumerated. No raw content, secrets, or prompts.

phases.description: Build the DuckDB-based analytics engine (rig_relay/analytics/) with unified ingestion over all canonical sources. CLI scripts/rig_relay_analytics.py with subcommands: scan-sessions, ingest-all, query, view, export.

Extend ProjectionWebSocketServer to emit analytics projection envelopes. Build 8 cockpit widgets at compact/standard/expanded disclosure levels. Reuse existing frontend widget infrastructure from rig_relay/desktop/projection_widgets.py.
deliverables: extend rig.relay.desktop_projection.v1 schema with analytics key

phases.description: Wire analytics widgets into the desktop cockpit layout. Add 'Analytics' layout mode to the existing Operator/Review/System/Technical modes. Add analytics panel to sidebar navigation.

Wire analytics regeneration into CI. On each push to main, regenerate derived analytics artifacts and commit. Agents and cockpit consume pre-computed artifacts for instant answers. Add CSV/Parquet export from full-page widget views.
